reports.text: Margaret, 81, has dementia and left home on foot this afternoon without telling anyone. A neighbour saw Margaret set off towards the south-west. Family say Margaret is fit and walks a lot.
A dog walker reports seeing someone matching Margaret's description about 15 minutes ago, roughly 1.7 km south-west of the house, in open fields.

hypotheses.name: South-west along footpaths per neighbour
hypotheses.reason: Neighbour direction taken at face value, continued walking on paths

hypotheses.name: Wandered opposite way - witness mistaken
hypotheses.reason: Witnesses often mistaken, dementia wander can be any direction

hypotheses.name: Drawn to streams and ponds
hypotheses.reason: Water features present and dementia cases often found near water

hypotheses.name: Still very close, confused or sheltering
hypotheses.reason: Elderly with dementia may become confused, stop and shelter in scrub/forest nearby
